works.abstract: The mechanical design industry has increasingly shifted towards adopting sustainability practices due to rising environmental concerns and the need for resource conservation. This paper explores the role of green materials and energy-efficient solutions in mechanical design, focusing on reducing environmental impacts throughout the product lifecycle. We analyze the latest advancements in green material technologies such as biodegradable plastics, composites, and sustainable metals, as well as the implementation of energy-efficient design strategies. The study also emphasizes the role of mechanical engineers in designing products that align with the principles of the circular economy, highlighting the integration of eco-friendly materials with energy-saving designs. The paper concludes with a discussion on future trends and challenges in making mechanical design more sustainable.
works.journal: American Journal Of Mechanical Engineering And Technology
works.title: Sustainability in Mechanical Design: Green Materials and Energy-Efficient Solutions
